name: Dormant account suddenly reactivated or high-velocity activity
description: A dormant or low-activity account suddenly shows high-velocity inflows and outflows.
fp: Seasonal use, life events or a customer returning after absence.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach (sector-specific guidance series, general principles)
FATF Recommendations, Recommendation 1 and Interpretive Note (assessing risks and applying a risk-based approach)
Wolfsberg Group, Guidance on a Risk Based Approach for Managing Money Laundering Risks (2006)
FATF, Opportunities and Challenges of New Technologies for AML/CFT (2021)
FinCEN, Advisory to Financial Institutions on Cyber-Events and Cyber-Enabled Crime (FIN-2016-A005, 2016)

links.name: Dormant account suddenly reactivated
links.ctx: Long-inactive account receives sudden large or high-velocity activity.
links.fp: Seasonal use and inheritance can reactivate accounts.

links.name: Account dormant then suddenly high-velocity inflows and outflows
links.ctx: Account opens, idles, then moves large funds quickly in a pass-through pattern.
